name: Transmission-only jurisdiction
desc: Limit FERC's reach to interconnections made directly to transmission (the seven-factor test), so state authority over generation and retail is untouched.

name: The 20 MW threshold
desc: Apply the reforms to new loads over 20 MW; DOE asked whether that line is right, or needed at all.

name: Study load with generation
desc: Study large loads and hybrid facilities together with generation, to site them efficiently and cut network upgrades.

name: Deposits, readiness, penalties
desc: Standardize study deposits, readiness requirements, and withdrawal penalties to deter speculative projects.

name: Hybrid injection/withdrawal rights
desc: Study hybrid load-plus-generation facilities by the injection and withdrawal rights they request.

name: System-protection facilities
desc: Require hybrids to install protection that blocks injections or withdrawals beyond their granted rights.

name: Expedited curtailable study
desc: Fast-track the study of loads and hybrids that agree to be curtailable and dispatchable.

name: 100% network-upgrade cost
desc: Make large loads pay 100% of the network upgrades they trigger; DOE asked about a crediting mechanism.

name: Study process & alt-tech
desc: How interconnection studies, queues, and readiness rules should work, and where grid-enhancing or alternative transmission technologies fit.

name: Cost allocation & transparency
desc: Who pays for the network upgrades a large load triggers, and how those costs are allocated and disclosed.

name: Co-location / behind-the-meter
desc: Rules for load sited with generation behind the meter or on the same site, including whether and how it interconnects.

name: Flexible-load services
desc: Treatment of loads that agree to curtail or be dispatched, and the faster study and services they earn in return.

name: Proximate-generation interconnection
desc: How co-located or nearby load-plus-generation (hybrid) facilities are studied and interconnected together.

name: MISO
desc: Positions engaging the Midcontinent ISO (MISO) specifically.

name: SPP
desc: Positions engaging the Southwest Power Pool (SPP) specifically.

name: CAISO
desc: Positions engaging the California ISO (CAISO) specifically.

name: ISO-NE
desc: Positions engaging ISO New England (ISO-NE) specifically.

name: NYISO
desc: Positions engaging the New York ISO (NYISO) specifically.

name: Grid reliability must not be compromised
Cost causation for large load developers
Limit NERC registration to new loads
